summary: Iteration 6 — Full validation of the SwissCarInfo unconfigured-mode enrichment + document scan PDF assembly features. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases in test_tech_enrich_and_scan_pdf.py PASS (12.4 s). Covered: (1) GET /api/technical-data/status → {configured:false, provider:null}; (2) POST /api/vehicles/{id}/enrich-technical returns HTTP 503 with the exact French message 'Fournisseur de données techniques non configuré — renseignez SWISSCARINFO_API_KEY puis redémarrez le backend.' and 404 for unknown vehicle; (3) POST /enrich-technical/apply with {conso_officielle_l_100km:6.5, conso_officielle_norme:'WLTP'} on vehicle BE 579928 (d1099b53) applied both fields, created vehicle_field_meta rows with source='external_vehicle_database' / provider='swisscarinfo' / source_ref='plate' (verified via GET /field-meta), and produced an audit-log entry containing 'Base technique SwissCarInfo' (verified via GET /history); original values (7.2 WLTP / 198 CO₂) restored after test; (4) CAN guard: seeded a navixy_can meta on co2_g_km, then apply with co2_g_km=999.0 → applied=0 and co2_g_km unchanged; meta cleaned up; (5) Scan as_pdf=1 with two synthetic JPEGs → single-entry pages[], content_type='application/pdf', filename scan-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.pdf, downloadable via /api/files/{path} with valid %PDF magic header (72 KB); (6) Regression: same endpoint without as_pdf keeps JPEG content_type and original filename. Frontend: Playwright drove the whole dashboard → Véhicules → BE 579928 drawer → Carte grise flow. Dashboard, Véhicules, Échéances, Alertes all load cleanly. In the Carte grise tab, data-testid='tech-enrich-btn' (label 'Base technique') is visible inside the 'Données moteur & consommation' card; clicking it opens data-testid='tech-enrich-dialog' which shows data-testid='tech-error-message' with the same French 503 detail; there is NO tech-retry-btn (correct in non-configuré mode) and the Fermer button dismisses cleanly. The Scan intelligent card is present with cg-scan-camera + cg-scan-import buttons; clicking cg-scan-camera opens the ScanDocumentDialog with forced type 'Permis de circulation' and the camera view mounts (scan-camera-view rendered — Playwright grants a fake video device by default in this env, so the scan-camera-error banner is not exercised; per iter-5 context this branch is covered when getUserMedia is denied). /scanner/opencv.js (8.98 MB) and /scanner/jscanify.min.js (2.6 KB) both serve HTTP 200 from the frontend. Console: the only error observed is the expected 503 from POST /enrich-technical (Failed to load resource: 503) — no other runtime errors on any tested screen.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L1429/L1434: raw = {k: {value:v, confidence:null} for k,v in main.items() if k not in can_locked} — this filters SwissCarInfo-provided keys against can_locked, but a review of enrich-technical/apply (L1455) also re-checks 'if key in can_locked: continue'. Good defense-in-depth, but the two exclusion sites should ideally share a helper to avoid drift if TECH_FIELD_DEFS grows.

extraction.enhance_and_pdf: no guard if images_bytes is empty (would raise IndexError at pil_pages[0]). server.py currently only calls it when inputs is non-empty AND all non-pdf, so safe today; still, prepend a defensive 'if not pil_pages: raise ValueError(...)' to fail fast if refactored.

TechnicalApply model uses Optional[str]='' with a JSON body — FastAPI will reject a client that sends null for matched_by. Consider Optional[str]=None or a validator to coerce null→'' since audit trail writes source_ref=payload.matched_by verbatim (would store None otherwise).
get_technical_provider() reads SWISSCARINFO_API_KEY on every request — cheap but consider memoising (LRU) so future providers with SDK objects avoid re-instantiation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the required assertions (tech-enrich dialog, cg-scan buttons, /scanner asset serving, all main routes render)

seed_data_creation: Two in-memory synthetic JPEGs generated via PIL for the scan tests (page1.jpg / page2.jpg / classic.jpg), and a transient vehicle_field_meta seeded via MongoClient on BE 579928 (co2_g_km, provider=navixy_can) for the CAN guard test. All test documents deleted via DELETE /api/documents/{id} + db.documents.delete_one; test metas cleaned via db.vehicle_field_meta.delete_*; original vehicle values (conso 7.2 WLTP, co2 198) restored via mongo update. No residual test data.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in backend/.env is used for OCR; SWISSCARINFO_API_KEY intentionally unset (feature under test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: For SwissCarInfo enrichment tests always use vehicle_id d1099b53-a118-42d8-adfc-3d1b9e1fdcb0 (plate BE 579928) — it has stable conso_officielle_l_100km=7.2 WLTP, co2_g_km=198 WLTP, and conso_reelle_l_100km=8.1 (manual) which must be preserved. Testids confirmed live: tech-enrich-btn, tech-enrich-dialog, tech-error-message, tech-retry-btn (absent when unconfigured), cg-scan-camera, cg-scan-import, scan-camera-view, scan-camera-error, scan-camera-cancel, scan-pdf-note (only after ≥1 page added). Playwright grants fake camera by default in this env so scan-camera-view mounts even in headless; to exercise scan-camera-error use browser context with permissions=[] or override navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia. /scanner/opencv.js is 8.98 MB — allow 15-30 s for first-load lazy fetch. The scan endpoint with as_pdf=1 correctly enhances-and-assembles (via Pillow) into a single-entry pages[] document; when as_pdf is absent the classic per-file JPEG storage still works. All tests self-clean (docs deleted, metas removed, vehicle values restored).
rca_of_the_issue: No defects found. All 7 backend cases and the frontend happy paths behaved exactly as spec'd. The Assurance/Leasing tab clicks in the Playwright run timed out because the scan dialog opened by an earlier cg-scan-camera click was still modally blocking — a test-flow artifact, not a product bug (the previous iteration already validated those tabs' scan cards).
